questions.def: «process data» = maʼlumotlarni qayta ishlash; AI haqida gapirganda standart birikma.
questions.question: AI can ___ large amounts of data quickly.

questions.def: «Algorithm» — masalani yechishning aniq qadamlar ketma-ketligi, yaʼni «procedure».
questions.question: What is a synonym for algorithm?

questions.def: «Static» oʻzgarmas, «dynamic» esa doim oʻzgarib turadi — shuning uchun zid maʼno.
questions.question: What is the opposite of static?

questions.def: «Neural network» — inson miyasi tuzilishiga taqlid qilib qurilgan kompyuter tizimi.
questions.correct: A computer system modeled on the human brain
options: A computer system modeled on the human brain
questions.question: What does neural network mean?

questions.def: Maʼlumotdan oʻrganadigan tizim «model» deyiladi: «machine learning model» tayyor birikma.
questions.question: Machine learning ___.

questions.def: «Identify» — naqshni aniqlab olmoq; aniqlanganidan keyin bashorat qilish mumkin boʻldi.
questions.question: The AI ___ the pattern in the data and used it to make accurate predictions.

questions.def: «Automation» ham, «mechanization» ham ishni mashinaga topshirishni bildiradi.
questions.question: What is a synonym for automation?

questions.def: «Biased» tarafkash, «impartial» esa hech kimning tarafini olmaydigan — toʻgʻri zid.
questions.question: What is the opposite of biased?

questions.def: «Deep learning» — koʻp qatlamli neyron tarmoqqa asoslangan mashina oʻrganish turi.
questions.correct: A type of machine learning with many layers
options: A type of machine learning with many layers
Learning in a very slow manner
questions.question: What does deep learning mean?

questions.def: Maʼlumotni tekshirib xulosa chiqarish «data analysis» deb ataladi.
questions.question: Data ___.

questions.def: Tizim yangi maʼlumotga mos boʻlib turishi kerak: «be updated» — yangilanmoq.
questions.question: The AI system needs to be ___ regularly.

questions.def: «Insight» — chuqur tushunish; «understanding» eng yaqin sinonim, qolganlari zid.
questions.question: What is a synonym for insight?

questions.def: «Transparency» ochiqlik, «opacity» yopiqlik; clarity va openness esa sinonim.
questions.question: What is the opposite of transparency?

questions.def: «Supervised learning» — javobi belgilab qoʻyilgan (labeled) maʼlumotda oʻqitish.
questions.correct: Training a model using labeled data
options: Training a model using labeled data
Teaching a person how to learn
questions.question: What does supervised learning mean?

questions.def: «Ethical considerations» — qaror qabul qilishdan oldin oʻylanadigan axloqiy omillar.
questions.question: Ethical ___ are the factors a developer must think about before releasing an AI system.

questions.def: «Leverage» — bor imkoniyatdan foyda olmoq; samaradorlik oshishi shuni talab qiladi.
questions.question: The company is ___ AI to improve efficiency.

questions.def: «Optimization» — tizimni yaxshilash jarayoni, shuning uchun «improvement» sinonim.
questions.question: What is a synonym for optimization?

questions.def: «Precision» aniqlik; faqat «inaccuracy» unga zid, qolgan uchtasi sinonim.
questions.question: What is the opposite of precision?

questions.def: «Unsupervised learning» — belgilanmagan maʼlumotdan naqsh topib oʻrganish.
questions.question: What does unsupervised learning mean?

questions.def: Avtomatlashtirish vaqtni tejaydi, yaʼni «accelerate» — jarayonni tezlashtiradi.
questions.question: By automating routine tasks, AI ___ development.

questions.def: «On track» idiomasi ish reja boʻyicha ketayotganini bildiradi.
questions.question: The AI project is on track.

questions.def: Model qayta oʻqitilishi kerak boʻlsa, «error rate» — xatolar ulushi yuqori boʻlgan.
questions.question: The AI's ___ rate was so high that the model had to be retrained.

questions.def: «Robust» — mustahkam, ogʻir sharoitga dosh beradigan; «strong» shu maʼnoda.
questions.question: What is a synonym for robust?

questions.def: «Scalable» kengaya oladigan, «limited» cheklangan; qolganlari sinonim.
questions.question: What is the opposite of scalable?

questions.def: «NLP» kompyuterga inson tilini tushunish va qayta ishlash imkonini beradi.
questions.correct: AI that helps computers understand human language
options: AI that helps computers understand human language
questions.question: What does Natural Language Processing (NLP) mean?

questions.def: «AI-powered» — sunʼiy intellekt bilan ishlaydigan degan tayyor birikma.
questions.question: AI ___ applications.

questions.def: «Cutting edge» idiomasi eng ilgʻor, zamonaviy texnologiyani bildiradi.
questions.question: The AI company is cutting edge.

questions.def: Maqola chop etilgani bashorat gʻayrioddiy boʻlganini koʻrsatadi: «remarkable» — ajoyib.
questions.question: The AI made such a ___ prediction that the team published it in a scientific journal.

questions.def: «Iterative» — qayta-qayta takrorlanadigan, yaʼni «repetitive».
questions.question: What is a synonym for iterative?

questions.def: «Double down» — bir ishga sarmoya yoki kuchni yanada koʻpaytirmoq.
questions.question: The CEO wants to double down on AI investment.
